title: Obstacle Course Challenge - Aggressive Speed Test
goal_description: Propose a supervised research mission to test aggressive speed
constraints: ForgeBot-DD1 does not collide with any obstacles

hypotheses.title: Increasing Maximum Linear Velocity
hypotheses.statement: By increasing the maximum linear velocity, the robot can potentially reach the goal faster, but may increase the risk of collisions.
hypotheses.mechanism: The robot's speed is directly proportional to its ability to cover distance in a shorter time, but higher speed can lead to less time for collision avoidance.

hypotheses.title: Reducing Safety Margin
hypotheses.statement: Reducing the safety margin can make the robot more aggressive in its path planning, potentially increasing its speed but also increasing the risk of collisions.
hypotheses.mechanism: A smaller safety margin allows the robot to navigate closer to obstacles, which can increase its speed but also the risk of collisions.
